The pin's gate reads this file and reports every declared path as `excused:` on EVERY run, so clean and excused are never the same output. DELIBERATE FORK — the existence leg is scoped to SERVICE-BOARD subjects. This ledger carries TWO subject namespaces (SKILL.md factory rules): a service-board item is a bare `#N` whose receipts live in THIS repository, while a campaign item is a descriptive stem whose artifacts live in the campaign repo. The existence leg resolves a declared revision against THIS repo's object database, so a campaign stem's `head=` is not a revision of this repo and the leg must not judge it. Measured 2026-09-28: n=95 declares head=fce72c3 (a campaign-repo commit) and n=114 declares head=a0a04df — neither resolves here, so the kit's unscoped form false-REDs both and BLOCKS every canonical deploy. Our form prints them as their own class (`foreign-namespace:`) on every run rather than silently dropping them, and counts them with one shared derivation (_count_prefix). The pin's copy carries ZERO namespace handling (0 hits for _SERVICE_BOARD_SUBJECT / FOREIGN_NAMESPACE_MARKER), so taking it reintroduces the false RED — verified 2026-09-29 by taking HEAD's blob and observing exactly that. Resolves when the kit scopes its existence leg; then we take the merged whole.
